data.name: Zaphira
data.long_meaning: Zaphira is a Hebrew name derived from the root word 'zaphar' meaning 'to hide' or 'be gracious'. In the Bible, Zaphira was the name of a Gileadite man who donated a field to the tabernacle. When the land was distributed among the tribes, the tribe of Simeon received this land, and it was named after the generous donor.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's graciousness and generosity towards us.
